newsitem.title: INDIA: Reserve Bank of India resumes dlr buying in swaps.
newsitem.headline: Reserve Bank of India resumes dlr buying in swaps.

text.p: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) bought August dollars in swap deals in mid-afternoon trade on Monday, dealers said.
Spot August dollars fell to 1.27/1.29 rupees in afternoon deals compared with 1.28/1.31 rupees at opening, they said. The RBI bought dollars in the swap market last week.
The spot dollar also weakened to 35.892/900 rupees from the opening level of 35.92/93, dealers said.

They attribute the rupee's gains to a slackening of dollar demand. A statement by the chairman of the State Bank of India (SBI), who said in an interview to Reuters he expected the dollar to remain stable in the near term, also affected sentiment, dealers said.
